description: This Java source file defines the service class `LoanTransactionService` within the Fineract project, responsible for managing and processing loan transactions, including filtering transactions for reprocessing and checking transaction chronology.

classes.name: LoanTransactionService
classes.description: Service class for managing loan transactions, providing methods to retrieve transactions for reprocessing and to determine transaction chronology.

methods.name: retrieveListOfTransactionsForReprocessing
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loan transactions that are eligible for reprocessing, filtered and sorted.

methods.name: isChronologicallyLatestRepaymentOrWaiver
methods.description: Checks if a given transaction is the latest (chronologically) repayment or waiver for the loan.

methods.name: loanTransactionForReprocessingPredicate
methods.description: Defines the predicate to filter transactions that are eligible for reprocessing based on certain conditions.
